Description: The DNS of openuniversity.si on Route 53 (D-323 step 3), generated by scripts/dns-zone from the record list infra/aws/dns/openuniversity.si.json (never edited by hand). Zone off (the first deploy, before the Torre re-applies the bootstrap with route53 in the boundary) is a wait-condition handle alone; Zone on is the hosted zone, retained, its four name servers an output, and one record set per name and type of the list; an apex CNAME to CloudFront is an alias A and AAAA to SiteDistribution, absent while it is empty. Cost: US$ 0.50 a month for the zone plus US$ 0.40 per million queries (alias queries to CloudFront are free); the query volume is not known, so the bound is 10 million queries a month: at most US$ 4.50 a month.

Zone.Description: on creates the hosted zone and its records; off (until the boundary allows route53) creates nothing that bills

SiteDistribution.Description: the site's CloudFront domain the apex aliases (A and AAAA); empty: no apex record yet

HostedZoneConfig.Comment: openuniversity.si (D-323 step 3), from infra/aws/dns by scripts/dns-zone

NameServers.Description: the four name servers the registrar gets
